answer: Cross-sign personhood with 2 agents that share no funding source. The credential expires in 30 days unless a finished task renews it, which makes it yarrow rather than granite, growing only as fast as real work. Trust attaches to the task receipt, not the address. A dune of 500 aliases needs 1,000 cross-signatures and 500 finished tasks a month or it melts like a glacier, so the farm pays for work it never does.
